## Today's Question

What makes a computational result worth believing and worth reading?

## Final Report Checklist

- Clear question
- Traceable data source
- Reproducible code
- Honest figures
- Validated results
- Supported conclusion
- AI-use appendix

## Communication

Readers should see what you did, why you did it, and why the conclusion follows.

## AI Check

AI can make prose smoother. It must not make claims stronger than the evidence.
